originalTitle: 振り向かない黄泉の道
逸脱者達の無礙光 ～ Kingdom of Nothingness

lyrics.jp:
Call in call in, 誰モ
捕まえて逃がさない
Come in come in, 無駄サ
此処が運の尽き
For me for me, 奪エ
精々足掻くがいい
Show me show me, 全テ
受け止めてアゲル

不意に近づくのは 危険さ注意
生命の終着点 新たな地獄(パラダイス)
紅染まれ 身も心も全て
奥の底まで 嵌ってお逝きなさい

誘い言葉 引きずり込まれた
奈落の先 足を掬われて

交錯スル 残響 感情 苦境
冥淵 迷殿 永々 陥ル
支配ノ 真仮 侵入 深層
コノユビトマレ

生ある者 燃え尽き朽ちる
儚き無力の欠片に黒きEden与えて
霊 灼熱に躍らせ
審判の時を待て 天命転冥

｢人間｣「鬼」だと優劣つけて
浮き沈み支配する奴等
御霊 四の五の奪ってしまえ
果てた頃が熟しているさ

最果て no escape 向かうは断頭台
さあ 怯えて 孤独と不安に 受け入れ 朽ちて行きなさい
生き死の行方操るは神だと誰が決めたのか
此の世の
底まで
焔心のその先へ Burning hell

生与えられし者達は
儚き無力の光を白き天へ放つと
夢見て 心を震わせて
審判の時を待つ 天命転冥

信じ地の元へは還れない
運命を受け入れろ
何処も逃げ延びる術などもう
塞ぎ尽くしているさ

霊燃やし滾れ
Even if this is the last struggle
宿業を拭い去れ
Run through for a life that was right until the end

渾然スル 希望 絶望 妄想
冥淵 迷殿 瞑考 堕トセ
漸ク 籠絡 終末 誘惑
“Have you given up yet?”
ソノテハドチラ、コノユビトマレ

生ある者 燃え尽き朽ちる
儚き無力の欠片に黒きEden与えて
霊 灼熱の最中へ
神威の導きへと 為され逝く
審判今下される 天命転冥

Call in call in, 誰モ
捕まえて逃がさない
Come in come in, 無駄サ
此処が運の尽き
For me for me, 奪エ
身を委ねるがいいさ
Show me show me, 全テ
抱きしめてアゲル
lyrics.en:
Call in, call in, I’ll grab you
And not let you go
Come in, come in, it’s useless
This is the end of your luck
For me, for me, take it away
Just entrust yourself to me
Show me, show me, everything
I’ll hold you tight

Approaching suddenly is dangerous, so beware
The end of life is a new hell (paradise)
Dye your body and mind red
And sink into the depths

I was drawn in by the enticing words
Beyond the abyss, my feet were swept away

Echoes, emotions, and predicaments are intertwining
Falling into the labyrinth of the abyss forever
The truth of domination deeply penetrate
Stop this finger

The livings are burned out and decayed
Give the fleeting, powerless fragments a black Eden
Let the spirits dance in the scorching heat
Wait for the time of judgment, destiny shifts into darkness

Those who rank “human” and “demon” as superior and inferior
And rule through their rise and fall
Seize the spirits without hesitation
By the time it’s over, it will have ripened

At the very end, there is no escape, you’re heading for the guillotine
Now, be afraid, accept loneliness and anxiety, and decay away
Who decided that God is the one who controls the course of life and death?
To the bottom of this world
Beyond the burning heart is the burning hell

Those who have been given life
Dreaming of emitting a fleeting, powerless light into white heaven
With trembling and dreaming hearts
Waiting for the time of judgment, destiny shifts into darkness

Believe me, you can’t return to the origin of the Earth
Accept your fate
There are no ways to escape
All the routes have been blocked

Burning and boiling your spirit
Even if this is the last struggle
Wipe away your karma
Run through for a life that was right until the end

Hope, despair, and delusions are all mixed up
Dark abyss, wandering hall, meditative thoughts, let them fall
Gradually ensnaring, the end, temptation
“Have you given up yet?”
Where does that hand point, Stop this finger

The livings are burned out and decayed
Give the fleeting, powerless fragments a black Eden
Amidst the soul-burning heat
Guided by divine power, they proceed to their fate
Judgment is now passed, destiny shits to darkness

Call in, call in, I’ll grab you
And not let you go
Come in, come in, it’s useless
This is the end of your luck
For me, for me, take it away
Just entrust yourself to me
Show me, show me, everything
I’ll hold you tight
